rules.description: A van carries at most 110 trays this week (its racks hold 120).
Vans leave no earlier than 05:00 and are back at the kitchen by 09:00.
V2 is in the workshop on Monday until 06:40 and leaves the kitchen no earlier than that.
No delivery to the café that is closed this week (Maple Row café (C14)).
Every open café receives all its trays in exactly one visit.
Partner-brand cafés (chilled products) are served only by the refrigerated van.
